task: Issue #563: velero-ui 0.10.1 endpoints without an upstream policy check (/api/stats, /api/form/*, /api/settings/velero/*, /api/config). Decide per endpoint between gateway block, admin check and allow without widening access or breaking the cluster-admin UI pages.

events.summary: Change only the velero-ui ApisixRoute (one new 403 rule) and docs/pins. Deliberately left alone: the policy file, the bulk-download rule, Keycloak clients, CORS, other apps, live cluster, Gitea.

Issue #563 read: velero-ui 0.10.1 controllers for stats, form, settings (server, ui, plugins DELETE) and the public config carry no @CheckPolicies; DELETE /api/settings/velero/plugins/:name is reachable by any logged-in user (it returns {} and removes nothing). Confirmed from the v0.10.1 controller source, not against the live cluster.

events.provenance: otwld/velero-ui tag v0.10.1 source read via gh api: app-config, form, settings, stats, health controllers, main.ts, auth.service.ts, oauth.strategy.ts and the Vue composables/components that call them; 2026-11-06
events.summary: stats/form/settings server|ui carry no CheckPolicies and are called by the Dashboard, the create/restore/schedule/location forms and the Settings page; config is @Public and called before login; DELETE plugins/:name returns {} and has no UI caller; the session JWT carries permissions but is signed with a runtime-generated key the gateway does not hold.

D-VELERO-UI-563: velero-ui-block-plugin-delete (DELETE, case-insensitive regex, priority 10, 403 for everyone). Other endpoints stay open: no gateway identity on an app-native OAuth route, and blocking breaks cluster-admin pages. Access is not widened: one path newly closed, nothing opened.

events.scope: Static: R319 parses the Helm-template routes as text, checks the new rule and the kept bulk-download rule, asserts no rule closes any UI path, and rejects 9 mutations. NOT covered: live gateway behavior, a browser session, an APISIX regex edge case on the live cluster.

events.summary: In the repository the plugin DELETE stub is closed at the gateway and the remaining unguarded endpoints are documented as a deliberate, pinned decision. The exposure to non-admin Keycloak users on stats/form/settings/config remains; removing it needs a Keycloak client group restriction or an upstream fix.

Complete for the repository scope: the stub endpoint is closed and the open endpoints are a documented, pinned decision. Not deployed or verified live; the Keycloak-side group restriction and an upstream fix remain open options, not claimed here.
